text:
Priya K.: Heads-up — APAC vendor XML invoices for March landed with a missing <usage> block for several hosted customers. Our rev schedule import failed for those lines so deferrals didn't post.
Alex M.: ugh. Which feed? the s3 drop or the API push?
Priya K.: S3 drop. 2026-03-31 02:10 UTC. File: invoices_apac_20260331.xml. BillingBot: [automated] import_failed: invoices_apac_20260331.xml — error: missing element 'usage' on invoice lines (x14).
Dana L.: Do we know affected revenue GL buckets? will this create a timing variance >$50k?
Priya K.: Quick scan shows ~12 invoices, total deferred rev expected ~$38.6k across hosted and dedicated SKUs — below the $50k policy but still needs manual deferral for month-end.
Jon S.: Can you paste a sanitized example of the bad XML fragment? easier to patch the parser if pattern is consistent.
Priya K.: Sure — here's an example (sanitized):
```
<invoice id="ACME-9987">
  <line>
    <item>hosted-monthly</item>
    <!-- missing <usage> block here -->
    <amount currency="USD">-137.50</amount>
  </line>
</invoice>
```
Alex M.: Looks like a transform step dropped empty usage nodes when quantity=0. We saw a similar bug in Q1 for trial-only invoices.
Maya A.: If we manual-adjust, what's the journal? Debit deferred revenue, credit revenue? Need the exact journal text for audit.
Dana L.: Yes — DR Deferred Revenue (Liability) $38,560 CR Hosted Revenue (Revenue) $38,560. Put memo: "Month-end manual deferral for missing usage nodes in APAC invoice import — file invoices_apac_20260331.xml"
Priya K.: I'll assemble a spreadsheet with invoice ids, customer, amount, and GL mapping. Can we get a quick review and approval to post a reversing entry on 2026-04-01?
Alex M.: +1 from eng to fix parser. I can push a hotfix to the transform today and re-run import for affected files — will coordinate with ops.
Jon S.: Ops: when you re-run, please run in dry-run mode first and attach the import log. Also include a checksum of the file after transform so finance can reconcile.
BillingBot: [automated] ticket_created: FIN-APAC-XML-176989 (title: APAC invoice XML missing usage block — manual deferrals needed)
Maya A.: For audit trail we need: ticket link, spreadsheet, proposed journal, and evidence of the fix. Priya, please cc me on the spreadsheet when ready.
Priya K.: Will do. Timeline: spreadsheet by EOD PST, manual journal entry to post tomorrow morning, eng hotfix + re-run within 24 hrs.
Dana L.: Sounds good. Flagging for month-end pack: include in close checklist under "manual deferrals".
Alex M.: I'll put a postmortem doc in drive after root cause confirmed.
Priya K.: Thanks all. tagging @finance-ops and @eng-runtime for visibility :white_check_mark:
